title: Apple Adds Virtual Original iPod to Apple Music 404 Page
excerpt: Apple Music features a hidden virtual recreation of the first-generation iPod on its 404 error page, complete with early 2000s music.
body_html:
Apple has introduced a hidden nod to its classic hardware by placing a virtual recreation of the first-generation iPod on the Apple Music 404 error page.

Discovered by social media users, the interactive easter egg allows visitors to experience a digital version of the iconic early 2000s music player. The virtual device comes pre-loaded with music from that era, including tracks like Coldplay's "Viva La Vida," offering a wave of nostalgia for users who encounter the broken link page.
